# Introduction  
The question is this: Is there a relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink?  
Data is from Uc Davis Math 116 class.  
$H_0$ There is no relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink.   
$H_A$ There is a relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink.
